findings.message: `$analysis_dir/simulation_results/all.csv` is read by the code but is not in the package. The documentation does not name it, but does describe restricted data ("confidential"), so it is most likely one of those.

`$analysis_dir/simulation_results/all_offer.csv` is read by the code but is not in the package. The documentation does not name it, but does describe restricted data ("confidential"), so it is most likely one of those.
`$analysis_dir/data_desc.dta` is read by the code but is not in the package. The documentation does not name it, but does describe restricted data ("confidential"), so it is most likely one of those.
No `version` statement in any do-file. Stata's behaviour depends on the version, so a rerun must choose one and log it.
Requires Stata; the desk says it has it.
9 file reads use paths built at run time (macros, globs, variables), so triage could not check that those inputs exist.
